# Jiaxing Mingzhi Textile Co., Ltd. (Mingzhi Sport Sock Factory)

> OEM / ODM sock manufacturer in Yuanhua Town, Jiaxing, Zhejiang, China. Established 2021.
> Custom jacquard, embroidery, sublimation and silicone-grip sport socks for brands, sports
> clubs and distributors. Minimum 100 pairs per style per colour; samples in 3-5 days; bulk
> in 20 days; quotations answered within 24 hours. The company does not sell online and
> publishes no unit prices — every order ends in a written quotation.

## Products

- [Jacquard socks](https://socks.jx-mingzhi.com/jacquard-socks.html): colour knitted into the fabric, up to 6 colours in a single row on 200-needle machines.
- [Embroidery socks](https://socks.jx-mingzhi.com/embroidery-socks.html): raised thread logo on cuff or leg, up to 8 thread colours.
- [Printing and sublimation socks](https://socks.jx-mingzhi.com/printing-socks.html): full-colour print, gradients and photographic artwork.
- [Grip socks](https://socks.jx-mingzhi.com/grip-socks.html): silicone, PVC or flocked grip on the sole, for Pilates, barre, trampoline and indoor training.
- [All sock styles](https://socks.jx-mingzhi.com/socks-we-make.html): six heights from no-show to thigh-high against four constructions, with typical reference heights (no-show 0 cm, ankle 3.5 cm, quarter 10 cm, crew 18 cm, knee-high and over-the-calf 35 cm, thigh-high over 40 cm), each measured flat from the centre of the heel to the top of the cuff — every length is knitted to the buyer's own measurement rather than to a fixed range. The MOQ and the one decision each height forces at sampling are on the same page.
- [Knee-high and thigh-high socks](https://socks.jx-mingzhi.com/knee-high-socks-manufacturer.html): 100 pairs per colour on every length — knee-high, over-the-calf or thigh-high; calf width in the size chart; not compression or medical hosiery.
- [Ankle and no-show socks](https://socks.jx-mingzhi.com/ankle-and-no-show-socks-manufacturer.html): 100 pairs per colour, no-show, ankle or quarter; the heel-fit decision that a spec sheet cannot settle.

## Buyer pages

- [Custom socks from 100 pairs](https://socks.jx-mingzhi.com/low-moq-custom-socks.html): the minimum counts per style and colourway, not per order; sizes can be split any way inside a colour.
- [Pilates grip socks wholesale](https://socks.jx-mingzhi.com/pilates-grip-socks-wholesale.html): PVC, silicone or flocked grip for studios and distributors; three-size runs; 5,000 pairs a day of grip capacity on one specification.
- [Custom club socks](https://socks.jx-mingzhi.com/custom-socks-for-clubs.html): two colourways, three or four sizes, names knitted, embroidered or printed; a six-week calendar from the first fixture backwards.
- [Sock supplier for Europe](https://socks.jx-mingzhi.com/sock-factory-for-europe.html): UK, Germany, France, Belgium, Austria and Italy; fibre labelling under Regulation (EU) 1007/2011, OEKO-TEX scope named by material, PPWR and textile EPR explained.

## Company facts

- [Factory and QC](https://socks.jx-mingzhi.com/factory.html): twenty to thirty circular knitting machines on one floor; knitting, linking, grip application and packing in the same building; larger volumes run through long-term partner factories on the same specification and the same approved pre-production sample.
- [Certificates](https://socks.jx-mingzhi.com/certificates.html): the CE / GPSD declaration and its test report are held by Jiaxing Mingzhi Textile. The OEKO-TEX Standard 100 certificates belong to the yarn supplier and the dyeing supplier, not to the knitter, and they cover cotton and elastane rather than every material. GRS is not held by the company.
- [Customization](https://socks.jx-mingzhi.com/customization.html): the five decisions settled before knitting, and a downloadable specification sheet.

## Notes

- [Sock construction, sizing, sampling and freight notes](https://socks.jx-mingzhi.com/news.html): 22 short technical notes written by the people who programme the machines.
